question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Inherent
solution:
The correct answer is '**Extraneous**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Inherent**' is '**Extraneous**'.
 
• **Inherent**: that is a basic or permanent part of somebody/something and that cannot be removed. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु का मूलवर्ती या स्‍थायी अंश; अंतर्निहित)
 
 
• *Example: The dangers of smoking are **inherent** to the habit.*
 
 
 
• **Extraneous** (अनावश्यक) - irrelevant or unrelated to the subject being dealt with.
 
 
• *Example: The argument made by the lawyer was filled with **extraneous** information.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Extraneous.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Natural** (प्राकृतिक) - existing in something as a permanent or essential characteristic.
 
• **Induce** (प्रेरित करना) - succeed in persuading or influencing someone to do something.
 
• **Restricted** (सीमित) - limited in range or scope.
